why: Both confirm the same hedgehog and brutal facts, but Analysis 1 refuses Halvard Six and the student brand cleanly and keeps the Listening Room scoped to violin-family strings, while Analysis 2 leaves open a capped guitar 'bullet' and piles on more stop-doing items and new seats.
